source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 7: The Past Perfect Tense

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ. Tìm vị trí lỗi, không chỉ chọn đáp án.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ, không liên quan đến field khác

starter.stem: She ___ already left when I arrived at the office.
starter.explanation_short: Hành động xảy ra trước 'arrived' → Past Perfect: had left.
starter.explanation_long: Past Perfect diễn tả hành động xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ. She had left (trước) → I arrived (sau).
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Đúng! Hành động trước trong quá khứ → had + V3
starter.ielts_tip: Had + V3 = hành động xảy ra trước trong quá khứ.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: has (Present Perfect), have (sai ngôi), was (sai cấu trúc)

starter.stem: By the time the meeting started, the manager had ___ the report.
starter.explanation_long: Past Perfect: had + past participle. Finish là động từ quy tắc: finished.
starter.feedback_wrong: Sau had phải dùng V3: finished.
starter.ielts_tip: had + V3. Quy tắc: thêm -ed. Bất quy tắc: phải nhớ.

starter.stem: The team ___ the project before the deadline passed.
starter.explanation_short: Trước 'the deadline passed' → Past Perfect: had completed.
starter.explanation_long: Hành động hoàn thành trước một mốc quá khứ (deadline passed) → Past Perfect.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Trước mốc quá khứ → had completed
starter.feedback_wrong: Trước 'deadline passed' → Past Perfect: had completed.
starter.ielts_tip: Before/By the time + Simple Past → mệnh đề trước dùng Past Perfect.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: completed (Simple Past), has completed (Present Perfect)

starter.stem: He had never ___ abroad before he got that IT job.
starter.explanation_long: Go là bất quy tắc: go → went (V2) → gone (V3). Sau had dùng V3: gone.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 go → went → gone. Sau had dùng V3!
starter.feedback_wrong: go → went (V2) → gone (V3). Sau had phải là V3.
starter.ielts_tip: V3 bất quy tắc phổ biến: go-went-gone, do-did-done, see-saw-seen.

starter.stem: By 2022, the company ___ its old servers with cloud technology.
starter.explanation_short: By 2022 = trước mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect: had replaced.
starter.explanation_long: 'By + mốc quá khứ' → Past Perfect: had replaced. 'By 2022' = trước năm 2022.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ By + mốc quá khứ → had replaced
starter.ielts_tip: By + thời gian quá khứ → Past Perfect. By + thời gian tương lai → Future Perfect.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: replaced (Simple Past), has replaced (Present Perfect)

starter.stem: After she ___ the training course, she applied for a promotion.
starter.explanation_short: After + hành động trước → Past Perfect: had finished.
starter.explanation_long: After + Past Perfect, Past Simple: After she had finished, she applied.
starter.feedback_wrong: After + hành động trước → Past Perfect: had finished.
starter.ielts_tip: After + had V3, S + V2. Before + S + V2, S + had V3.

starter.stem: The software ___ yesterday and caused several issues.
starter.explanation_short: yesterday = mốc cụ thể, không có hành động trước → Simple Past: crashed.
starter.explanation_long: Chỉ có 1 hành động trong quá khứ + yesterday → Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ dùng khi có 2 hành động, cần phân biệt trước/sau.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Chỉ 1 hành động + yesterday → Simple Past: crashed
starter.feedback_wrong: Chỉ 1 hành động quá khứ → Simple Past. Past Perfect cần 2 hành động.
starter.ielts_tip: Past Perfect CHỈ dùng khi cần phân biệt 2 hành động trước/sau trong quá khứ.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: had crashed (không cần Past Perfect ở đây)

starter.stem: I realized I ___ my laptop at the office when I got home.
starter.explanation_short: Quên (trước) → nhận ra (sau) → Past Perfect: had forgotten.
starter.explanation_long: Hành động quên xảy ra trước hành động nhận ra → Past Perfect: had forgotten.
starter.feedback_wrong: Hành động trước → Past Perfect: had forgotten.
starter.ielts_tip: realized/discovered/noticed + had V3 = nhận ra điều đã xảy ra trước đó.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: forgot (Simple Past), have forgotten (Present Perfect)

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'When I arrived, the meeting already started.'
options: Sai: started → had started (hành động trước)
starter.correct_answer: Sai: started → had started (hành động trước)
starter.explanation_short: Meeting started (trước) → I arrived (sau) → had started.
starter.explanation_long: 'Already started' trước 'I arrived' → cần Past Perfect: had already started.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 started trước arrived → had already started
starter.feedback_wrong: Hành động trước → Past Perfect: had already started.
starter.ielts_tip: When + Simple Past, S + had already + V3.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: option B bẫy vì câu nghe tự nhiên trong tiếng Việt

starter.stem: They ___ never used video conferencing before the pandemic hit.
starter.explanation_short: Trước 'the pandemic hit' (quá khứ) → Past Perfect: had never used.
starter.explanation_long: 'Before the pandemic hit' = mốc quá khứ → hành động trước đó dùng Past Perfect: had never used.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Trước mốc quá khứ → had never used
starter.feedback_wrong: Trước mốc quá khứ (pandemic hit) → Past Perfect: had.
starter.ielts_tip: had never + V3 + before + Simple Past = chưa bao giờ làm gì trước một mốc quá khứ.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: have (Present Perfect), has (sai ngôi), were (sai cấu trúc)

build_up.stem: The company had already implemented AI solutions before competitors ___ the trend.
build_up.explanation_short: Before + Simple Past: noticed. Mệnh đề trước dùng had implemented (Past Perfect).
build_up.explanation_long: Cấu trúc: S + had V3 + before + S + V2. 'Had implemented' (trước) + 'noticed' (sau).
build_up.feedback_wrong: Before + Simple Past. Mệnh đề chính dùng Past Perfect.
build_up.ielts_tip: S + had V3 + before + S + V2. Không dùng had cho cả hai mệnh đề.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: had noticed (dùng had cho cả hai vế = sai)

build_up.stem: The engineer ___ the code, tested it, and submitted the pull request.
build_up.explanation_short: 3 hành động liên tiếp theo thứ tự → Simple Past cho tất cả.
build_up.explanation_long: Khi các hành động xảy ra theo thứ tự tự nhiên (wrote → tested → submitted), không cần Past Perfect. Simple Past đủ rõ.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Hành động liên tiếp theo thứ tự → Simple Past
build_up.feedback_wrong: Hành động liên tiếp → Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ cần khi thứ tự không rõ.
build_up.ielts_tip: Khi thứ tự rõ ràng (and, then) → Simple Past. Chỉ dùng Past Perfect khi cần nhấn mạnh trước/sau.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: had written nghe có vẻ academic hơn nhưng không cần thiết

build_up.stem: By the end of the quarter, the sales team ___ all their targets.
build_up.explanation_short: By the end of the quarter = mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect: had achieved.
build_up.explanation_long: 'By the end of + thời gian quá khứ' → Past Perfect: had achieved. Hành động hoàn thành trước mốc đó.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 By the end of + quá khứ → had achieved
build_up.feedback_wrong: By the end of + mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect.
build_up.ielts_tip: By the time/end of + mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: achieved (Simple Past cũng gần đúng)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The company had launched a new product last Tuesday.'
options: had launched → launched (last Tuesday = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
a new product → the new product
build_up.correct_answer: had launched → launched (last Tuesday = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
build_up.explanation_short: last Tuesday + chỉ 1 hành động → Simple Past: launched.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Last Tuesday' = thời gian cụ thể + không có hành động thứ hai → dùng Simple Past, không cần Past Perfect.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 last Tuesday + 1 hành động → Simple Past: launched
build_up.feedback_wrong: Chỉ 1 hành động + thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past. Không cần had.
build_up.ielts_tip: Past Perfect CHỈ cần khi phân biệt 2 hành động trước/sau. 1 hành động → Simple Past.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B bẫy vì had launched nghe formal

build_up.stem: The manager said that the team ___ the deadline.
build_up.explanation_short: said (quá khứ) → hành động trước đó dùng Past Perfect: had missed.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported speech: 'said' (Simple Past) → lùi thì: missed → had missed (Past Perfect).
build_up.feedback_wrong: Reported speech: said → lùi thì → had missed.
build_up.ielts_tip: Reported speech: said/told + had V3. Lùi 1 bậc từ Simple Past.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: missed (cũng được chấp nhận trong informal nhưng had missed chuẩn hơn)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The developer had wrote the documentation before submitting the code.'
build_up.explanation_short: had + V3: write → wrote (V2) → written (V3). Had wrote = sai.
build_up.explanation_long: Write là bất quy tắc: write-wrote-written. Sau had phải dùng V3: written, không phải V2: wrote.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 write-wrote-written. Sau had dùng V3: written!
build_up.feedback_wrong: had + V3: written. Không dùng V2 (wrote) sau had.
build_up.ielts_tip: Lỗi phổ biến: had went/had wrote/had took → had gone/written/taken.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B bẫy vì nghe tự nhiên

build_up.stem: The startup failed because it ___ enough market research.
build_up.explanation_short: Không làm research (trước) → thất bại (sau) → Past Perfect: hadn't done.
build_up.explanation_long: Nguyên nhân (hadn't done research) xảy ra trước kết quả (failed) → Past Perfect phủ định.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Nguyên nhân trước kết quả → hadn't done
build_up.feedback_wrong: Nguyên nhân xảy ra trước → Past Perfect: hadn't done.
build_up.ielts_tip: failed/succeeded because + had/hadn't V3 = giải thích nguyên nhân trước kết quả.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: didn't do (Simple Past cũng gần đúng nhưng kém chính xác)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'I wish I studied programming when I was younger.'
options: studied → had studied (wish + Past Perfect = tiếc nuối quá khứ)
build_up.correct_answer: studied → had studied (wish + Past Perfect = tiếc nuối quá khứ)
build_up.explanation_short: wish + Past Perfect = tiếc nuối về quá khứ: I wish I had studied.
build_up.explanation_long: 'I wish I had studied' = ước gì đã học (tiếc nuối quá khứ). 'I wish I studied' = ước gì đang học (hiện tại).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối quá khứ
build_up.feedback_wrong: wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối quá khứ: I wish I had studied.
build_up.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 2: I wish I had + V3... → diễn đạt tiếc nuối, tăng band Grammatical Range.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option C (was→were) cũng có thể đúng nhưng option A là lỗi chính

build_up.stem: The employees were frustrated because the system ___ three times that morning.
build_up.explanation_short: crashed 3 lần (trước) → frustrated (sau) → Past Perfect: had crashed.
build_up.explanation_long: Sự cố crash xảy ra trước trạng thái frustrated → Past Perfect: had crashed.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Sự kiện trước trạng thái → had crashed
build_up.feedback_wrong: Hành động trước trạng thái quá khứ → Past Perfect.
build_up.ielts_tip: were + adj + because + had V3 = giải thích trạng thái bằng hành động trước đó.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: crashed (Simple Past cũng gần đúng)

build_up.stem: Once the team ___ the testing phase, they moved on to deployment.
build_up.explanation_short: Once + hành động hoàn thành trước → Past Perfect: had completed.
build_up.explanation_long: Once + Past Perfect, Past Simple: Once they had completed (trước), they moved on (sau).
build_up.feedback_wrong: Once + Past Perfect, Simple Past: had completed, moved on.
build_up.ielts_tip: Once/After + had V3, S + V2. Cấu trúc mô tả trình tự sự kiện.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: completed (Simple Past cũng được nhưng kém chính xác)

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The IT team realized that a hacker accessed the system two hours before they detected the breach.'
options: that a hacker accessed the system
challenge.correct_answer: that a hacker accessed the system
challenge.explanation_short: accessed (trước) → realized (sau) → Past Perfect: had accessed.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: hacker accessed (trước) → team realized (sau) → cần Past Perfect: had accessed. Lớp 2: 'two hours before they detected' cũng củng cố thứ tự thời gian.
challenge.feedback_wrong: Hành động xảy ra trước → Past Perfect: had accessed.
challenge.ielts_tip: realized/discovered/found that + had V3 = phát hiện điều đã xảy ra trước.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D trông có vẻ sai nhưng detected = đúng thì

challenge.stem: Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT cho IELTS Writing Task 2:
options: The government had introduced new policies in 2020 and they had transformed the economy.
The government introduced new policies in 2020 and they transformed the economy.
The government had introduced new policies in 2020 and they transformed the economy.
The government introduced new policies in 2020 and they had transformed the economy.
challenge.correct_answer: The government introduced new policies in 2020 and they transformed the economy.
challenge.explanation_short: in 2020 + hành động theo thứ tự → Simple Past cho cả hai. Không cần Past Perfect.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'in 2020' = mốc cụ thể → Simple Past. Lớp 2: hai hành động theo thứ tự tự nhiên → Simple Past cho cả hai. Past Perfect không cần thiết ở đây.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Thứ tự rõ ràng + mốc cụ thể → Simple Past!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Khi thứ tự rõ ràng → Simple Past. Không lạm dụng Past Perfect.
challenge.ielts_tip: Không lạm dụng Past Perfect. Chỉ dùng khi CẦN phân biệt trước/sau.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A dùng had cho cả hai vế = lạm dụng

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The CEO announced that the company had grew significantly and had attract many investors.'
challenge.explanation_short: had + V3: grow → grew (V2) → grown (V3). Had grew = sai.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: grow-grew-grown. 'Had grew' → 'had grown'. Lớp 2: 'had attract' cũng sai → 'had attracted'. Cả B và C đều sai, nhưng B rõ ràng hơn.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 grow-grew-grown. Sau had dùng V3: grown!
challenge.feedback_wrong: had + V3: grown (không phải grew). Và: had attracted (không phải attract).
challenge.ielts_tip: V3 hay sai: grow→grown, know→known, show→shown, throw→thrown.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (had attract) cũng có lỗi — bẫy kép

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho IELTS Speaking Part 2 (kể về tiếc nuối):
options: I wish I learned coding skills when I was at university.
I wish I had learned coding skills when I was at university.
I wish I have learned coding skills when I was at university.
I wish I would learn coding skills when I was at university.
challenge.correct_answer: I wish I had learned coding skills when I was at university.
challenge.explanation_short: wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối về quá khứ: I wish I had learned.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: wish + Past Perfect = regret about the past. Lớp 2: 'when I was' = mốc quá khứ → xác nhận đây là tiếc nuối quá khứ.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối quá khứ hoàn hảo!
challenge.feedback_wrong: wish + had learned = tiếc nuối quá khứ. wish + V2 = ước ở hiện tại.
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 2: I wish I had + V3... → nâng band Grammatical Range.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (wish I learned) = ước hiện tại, không phải tiếc nuối quá khứ

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'By the time the company ___ [A] the problem, they already ___ [B] thousands of customers.'
challenge.explanation_short: By the time + Simple Past (discovered) → mệnh đề kia dùng Past Perfect (had lost).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'By the time + S + V2' → mệnh đề chính dùng Past Perfect. Lớp 2: lost (trước) → discovered (sau) → had already lost.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 By the time + V2, S + had V3!
challenge.feedback_wrong: By the time + discovered (V2) → had already lost (Past Perfect).
challenge.ielts_tip: By the time + V2, S + had V3. Cấu trúc phổ biến trong narrative essays.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B dùng had cho cả hai = sai cấu trúc

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The report stated that automation replaced many traditional jobs, which led to widespread unemployment.'
challenge.explanation_short: stated (quá khứ) → lùi thì: replaced → had replaced.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'stated' = reporting verb ở quá khứ → tense backshift: replaced → had replaced. Lớp 2: 'which led to' cũng nên lùi thành 'had led to' nhưng option B là lỗi chính.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Reported speech: stated → lùi thì → had replaced!
challenge.feedback_wrong: stated (quá khứ) → lùi thì → had replaced.
challenge.ielts_tip: Reported speech formal: said/stated/reported + had V3.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (led → had led) cũng có thể cần lùi thì

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Before the internet became widespread, people relied heavily on traditional media for information.
Before the internet had become widespread, people relied heavily on traditional media for information.
Before the internet became widespread, people had relied heavily on traditional media for information.
Before the internet had become widespread, people had relied heavily on traditional media for information.
challenge.correct_answer: Before the internet became widespread, people had relied heavily on traditional media for information.
challenge.explanation_short: Before + V2 (became) → mệnh đề chính dùng Past Perfect (had relied).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Before + Simple Past → Past Perfect cho hành động diễn ra trong khoảng thời gian trước đó. Lớp 2: had relied = trạng thái kéo dài trước mốc 'internet became widespread'.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Before + V2, S + had V3 = chuẩn nhất!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Before + became (V2), had relied (Past Perfect) = đúng thứ tự thì.
challenge.ielts_tip: Before + V2, S + had V3. Cấu trúc so sánh quá khứ trong Task 2.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A cũng đúng ngữ pháp nhưng kém chính xác về thứ tự thì

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The researchers had already began the experiment when the funding had been withdrew unexpectedly.'
challenge.explanation_short: had + V3: begin → began (V2) → begun (V3). Had began = sai.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: begin-began-begun. 'Had began' → 'had begun'. Lớp 2: 'had been withdrew' cũng sai → 'had been withdrawn'. Cả A và D đều sai, nhưng A sai rõ nhất.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 begin-began-begun. Sau had dùng V3: begun!
challenge.feedback_wrong: begin-began-begun. had begun (không phải began). Và: had been withdrawn.
challenge.ielts_tip: V3 hay nhầm: begin→begun, drink→drunk, sing→sung, swim→swum.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (withdrew → withdrawn) cũng sai — bẫy kép

challenge.stem:
Trong đoạn Task 2 sau, chỗ nào CẦN Past Perfect?
'The government ___ [A] new regulations. Companies ___ [B] to adapt. The economy eventually ___ [C].'
options: Không chỗ nào cần Past Perfect — tất cả Simple Past
challenge.correct_answer: Không chỗ nào cần Past Perfect — tất cả Simple Past
challenge.explanation_short: 3 hành động theo thứ tự tự nhiên → Simple Past cho tất cả.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: introduced → struggled → recovered = thứ tự tự nhiên, rõ ràng. Lớp 2: Không cần Past Perfect vì không có sự mơ hồ về thứ tự. Lớp 3: Dùng Past Perfect ở đây = lạm dụng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Thứ tự rõ ràng → Simple Past. Không lạm dụng Past Perfect!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Khi thứ tự rõ ràng → Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ cần khi có ambiguity.
challenge.ielts_tip: Narrative Task 2: hành động theo thứ tự → Simple Past. Chỉ dùng Past Perfect khi cần.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D bẫy vì nghĩ quá khứ = luôn cần Past Perfect

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'By the time the company [A] has realized the problem, thousands of users [B] already experienced data loss, which [C] had costed millions in damages.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] has realized → had realized. [B] already experienced → had already experienced. [C] had costed → had cost.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'By the time' + quá khứ → had realized (Past Perfect, không Present Perfect). Lớp 2: [B] 'already experienced' → 'had already experienced' (Past Perfect). Lớp 3: [C] 'costed' không tồn tại — cost-cost-cost (bất quy tắc không đổi) → 'had cost'.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] had realized | [B] had already experienced | [C] had cost!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] has→had. [B] cần had already. [C] cost-cost-cost (không phải costed).
challenge.ielts_tip: cost-cost-cost, cut-cut-cut, put-put-put = V1=V2=V3. Không thêm -ed!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B bỏ sót [B], option A bỏ sót [C]. Cả 3 đều sai.

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Starter
ui.description: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

items.stem: She ___ already left when I arrived at the office.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Đúng! Hành động trước trong quá khứ → had + V3
items.feedback_wrong: Trước 'arrived' → Past Perfect: had left.
items.explanation_short: Hành động xảy ra trước 'arrived' → Past Perfect: had left.
items.ielts_tip: Had + V3 = hành động xảy ra trước trong quá khứ.

items.stem: By the time the meeting started, the manager had ___ the report.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 had + V3 → had finished
items.feedback_wrong: Sau had phải dùng V3: finished.
items.explanation_short: had + V3: finish → finished.
items.ielts_tip: had + V3. Quy tắc: thêm -ed. Bất quy tắc: phải nhớ.

items.stem: The team ___ the project before the deadline passed.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Trước mốc quá khứ → had completed
items.feedback_wrong: Trước 'deadline passed' → Past Perfect: had completed.
items.explanation_short: Trước 'the deadline passed' → Past Perfect: had completed.
items.ielts_tip: Before/By the time + Simple Past → mệnh đề trước dùng Past Perfect.

items.stem: He had never ___ abroad before he got that IT job.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 go → went → gone. Sau had dùng V3!
items.feedback_wrong: go → went (V2) → gone (V3). Sau had phải là V3.
items.explanation_short: had + V3: go → went → gone.
items.ielts_tip: V3 bất quy tắc phổ biến: go-went-gone, do-did-done, see-saw-seen.

items.stem: By 2022, the company ___ its old servers with cloud technology.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ By + mốc quá khứ → had replaced
items.feedback_wrong: By 2022 → Past Perfect: had replaced.
items.explanation_short: By 2022 = trước mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect: had replaced.
items.ielts_tip: By + thời gian quá khứ → Past Perfect. By + thời gian tương lai → Future Perfect.

items.stem: After she ___ the training course, she applied for a promotion.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 After + Past Perfect → had finished
items.feedback_wrong: After + hành động trước → Past Perfect: had finished.
items.explanation_short: After + hành động trước → Past Perfect: had finished.
items.ielts_tip: After + had V3, S + V2. Before + S + V2, S + had V3.

items.stem: The software ___ yesterday and caused several issues.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Chỉ 1 hành động + yesterday → Simple Past: crashed
items.feedback_wrong: Chỉ 1 hành động quá khứ → Simple Past. Past Perfect cần 2 hành động.
items.explanation_short: yesterday = mốc cụ thể, không có hành động trước → Simple Past: crashed.
items.ielts_tip: Past Perfect CHỈ dùng khi cần phân biệt 2 hành động trước/sau trong quá khứ.

items.stem: I realized I ___ my laptop at the office when I got home.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Quên (trước) → nhận ra (sau) → had forgotten
items.feedback_wrong: Hành động trước → Past Perfect: had forgotten.
items.explanation_short: Quên (trước) → nhận ra (sau) → Past Perfect: had forgotten.
items.ielts_tip: realized/discovered/noticed + had V3 = nhận ra điều đã xảy ra trước đó.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'When I arrived, the meeting already started.'
options: Sai: started → had started (hành động trước)
items.correct_answer: Sai: started → had started (hành động trước)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 started trước arrived → had already started
items.feedback_wrong: Hành động trước → Past Perfect: had already started.
items.explanation_short: Meeting started (trước) → I arrived (sau) → had started.
items.ielts_tip: When + Simple Past, S + had already + V3.

items.stem: They ___ never used video conferencing before the pandemic hit.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Trước mốc quá khứ → had never used
items.feedback_wrong: Trước mốc quá khứ (pandemic hit) → Past Perfect: had.
items.explanation_short: Trước 'the pandemic hit' (quá khứ) → Past Perfect: had never used.
items.ielts_tip: had never + V3 + before + Simple Past = chưa bao giờ làm gì trước một mốc quá khứ.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Build Up
ui.description: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

items.stem: The company had already implemented AI solutions before competitors ___ the trend.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 had V3 + before + V2 → noticed
items.feedback_wrong: Before + Simple Past. Mệnh đề chính dùng Past Perfect.
items.explanation_short: Before + Simple Past: noticed. Mệnh đề trước dùng had implemented (Past Perfect).
items.ielts_tip: S + had V3 + before + S + V2. Không dùng had cho cả hai mệnh đề.

items.stem: The engineer ___ the code, tested it, and submitted the pull request.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Hành động liên tiếp theo thứ tự → Simple Past
items.feedback_wrong: Hành động liên tiếp → Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ cần khi thứ tự không rõ.
items.explanation_short: 3 hành động liên tiếp theo thứ tự → Simple Past cho tất cả.
items.ielts_tip: Khi thứ tự rõ ràng (and, then) → Simple Past. Chỉ dùng Past Perfect khi cần nhấn mạnh trước/sau.

items.stem: By the end of the quarter, the sales team ___ all their targets.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 By the end of + quá khứ → had achieved
items.feedback_wrong: By the end of + mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect.
items.explanation_short: By the end of the quarter = mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect: had achieved.
items.ielts_tip: By the time/end of + mốc quá khứ → Past Perfect.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The company had launched a new product last Tuesday.'
options: had launched → launched (last Tuesday = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
a new product → the new product
items.correct_answer: had launched → launched (last Tuesday = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 last Tuesday + 1 hành động → Simple Past: launched
items.feedback_wrong: Chỉ 1 hành động + thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past. Không cần had.
items.explanation_short: last Tuesday + chỉ 1 hành động → Simple Past: launched.
items.ielts_tip: Past Perfect CHỈ cần khi phân biệt 2 hành động trước/sau. 1 hành động → Simple Past.

items.stem: The manager said that the team ___ the deadline.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ said → lùi thì → had missed
items.feedback_wrong: Reported speech: said → lùi thì → had missed.
items.explanation_short: said (quá khứ) → hành động trước đó dùng Past Perfect: had missed.
items.ielts_tip: Reported speech: said/told + had V3. Lùi 1 bậc từ Simple Past.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The developer had wrote the documentation before submitting the code.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 write-wrote-written. Sau had dùng V3: written!
items.feedback_wrong: had + V3: written. Không dùng V2 (wrote) sau had.
items.explanation_short: had + V3: write → wrote (V2) → written (V3). Had wrote = sai.
items.ielts_tip: Lỗi phổ biến: had went/had wrote/had took → had gone/written/taken.

items.stem: The startup failed because it ___ enough market research.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Nguyên nhân trước kết quả → hadn't done
items.feedback_wrong: Nguyên nhân xảy ra trước → Past Perfect: hadn't done.
items.explanation_short: Không làm research (trước) → thất bại (sau) → Past Perfect: hadn't done.
items.ielts_tip: failed/succeeded because + had/hadn't V3 = giải thích nguyên nhân trước kết quả.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'I wish I studied programming when I was younger.'
options: studied → had studied (wish + Past Perfect = tiếc nuối quá khứ)
items.correct_answer: studied → had studied (wish + Past Perfect = tiếc nuối quá khứ)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối quá khứ
items.feedback_wrong: wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối quá khứ: I wish I had studied.
items.explanation_short: wish + Past Perfect = tiếc nuối về quá khứ: I wish I had studied.
items.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 2: I wish I had + V3... → diễn đạt tiếc nuối, tăng band Grammatical Range.

items.stem: The employees were frustrated because the system ___ three times that morning.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Sự kiện trước trạng thái → had crashed
items.feedback_wrong: Hành động trước trạng thái quá khứ → Past Perfect.
items.explanation_short: crashed 3 lần (trước) → frustrated (sau) → Past Perfect: had crashed.
items.ielts_tip: were + adj + because + had V3 = giải thích trạng thái bằng hành động trước đó.

items.stem: Once the team ___ the testing phase, they moved on to deployment.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Once + had V3 → had completed
items.feedback_wrong: Once + Past Perfect, Simple Past: had completed, moved on.
items.explanation_short: Once + hành động hoàn thành trước → Past Perfect: had completed.
items.ielts_tip: Once/After + had V3, S + V2. Cấu trúc mô tả trình tự sự kiện.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Challenge
ui.description: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ. Tìm vị trí lỗi, không chỉ chọn đáp án.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The IT team realized that a hacker accessed the system two hours before they detected the breach.'
options: that a hacker accessed the system
items.correct_answer: that a hacker accessed the system
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 accessed trước realized → had accessed!
items.feedback_wrong: Hành động xảy ra trước → Past Perfect: had accessed.
items.explanation_short: accessed (trước) → realized (sau) → Past Perfect: had accessed.
items.ielts_tip: realized/discovered/found that + had V3 = phát hiện điều đã xảy ra trước.

items.stem: Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT cho IELTS Writing Task 2:
options: The government had introduced new policies in 2020 and they had transformed the economy.
The government introduced new policies in 2020 and they transformed the economy.
The government had introduced new policies in 2020 and they transformed the economy.
The government introduced new policies in 2020 and they had transformed the economy.
items.correct_answer: The government introduced new policies in 2020 and they transformed the economy.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Thứ tự rõ ràng + mốc cụ thể → Simple Past!
items.feedback_wrong: Khi thứ tự rõ ràng → Simple Past. Không lạm dụng Past Perfect.
items.explanation_short: in 2020 + hành động theo thứ tự → Simple Past cho cả hai. Không cần Past Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: Không lạm dụng Past Perfect. Chỉ dùng khi CẦN phân biệt trước/sau.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The CEO announced that the company had grew significantly and had attract many investors.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 grow-grew-grown. Sau had dùng V3: grown!
items.feedback_wrong: had + V3: grown (không phải grew). Và: had attracted (không phải attract).
items.explanation_short: had + V3: grow → grew (V2) → grown (V3). Had grew = sai.
items.ielts_tip: V3 hay sai: grow→grown, know→known, show→shown, throw→thrown.

items.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho IELTS Speaking Part 2 (kể về tiếc nuối):
options: I wish I learned coding skills when I was at university.
I wish I had learned coding skills when I was at university.
I wish I have learned coding skills when I was at university.
I wish I would learn coding skills when I was at university.
items.correct_answer: I wish I had learned coding skills when I was at university.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối quá khứ hoàn hảo!
items.feedback_wrong: wish + had learned = tiếc nuối quá khứ. wish + V2 = ước ở hiện tại.
items.explanation_short: wish + had V3 = tiếc nuối về quá khứ: I wish I had learned.
items.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 2: I wish I had + V3... → nâng band Grammatical Range.

items.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'By the time the company ___ [A] the problem, they already ___ [B] thousands of customers.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 By the time + V2, S + had V3!
items.feedback_wrong: By the time + discovered (V2) → had already lost (Past Perfect).
items.explanation_short: By the time + Simple Past (discovered) → mệnh đề kia dùng Past Perfect (had lost).
items.ielts_tip: By the time + V2, S + had V3. Cấu trúc phổ biến trong narrative essays.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The report stated that automation replaced many traditional jobs, which led to widespread unemployment.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Reported speech: stated → lùi thì → had replaced!
items.feedback_wrong: stated (quá khứ) → lùi thì → had replaced.
items.explanation_short: stated (quá khứ) → lùi thì: replaced → had replaced.
items.ielts_tip: Reported speech formal: said/stated/reported + had V3.

items.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Before the internet became widespread, people relied heavily on traditional media for information.
Before the internet had become widespread, people relied heavily on traditional media for information.
Before the internet became widespread, people had relied heavily on traditional media for information.
Before the internet had become widespread, people had relied heavily on traditional media for information.
items.correct_answer: Before the internet became widespread, people had relied heavily on traditional media for information.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Before + V2, S + had V3 = chuẩn nhất!
items.feedback_wrong: Before + became (V2), had relied (Past Perfect) = đúng thứ tự thì.
items.explanation_short: Before + V2 (became) → mệnh đề chính dùng Past Perfect (had relied).
items.ielts_tip: Before + V2, S + had V3. Cấu trúc so sánh quá khứ trong Task 2.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The researchers had already began the experiment when the funding had been withdrew unexpectedly.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 begin-began-begun. Sau had dùng V3: begun!
items.feedback_wrong: begin-began-begun. had begun (không phải began). Và: had been withdrawn.
items.explanation_short: had + V3: begin → began (V2) → begun (V3). Had began = sai.
items.ielts_tip: V3 hay nhầm: begin→begun, drink→drunk, sing→sung, swim→swum.

items.stem:
Trong đoạn Task 2 sau, chỗ nào CẦN Past Perfect?
'The government ___ [A] new regulations. Companies ___ [B] to adapt. The economy eventually ___ [C].'
options: Không chỗ nào cần Past Perfect — tất cả Simple Past
items.correct_answer: Không chỗ nào cần Past Perfect — tất cả Simple Past
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Thứ tự rõ ràng → Simple Past. Không lạm dụng Past Perfect!
items.feedback_wrong: Khi thứ tự rõ ràng → Simple Past. Past Perfect chỉ cần khi có ambiguity.
items.explanation_short: 3 hành động theo thứ tự tự nhiên → Simple Past cho tất cả.
items.ielts_tip: Narrative Task 2: hành động theo thứ tự → Simple Past. Chỉ dùng Past Perfect khi cần.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'By the time the company [A] has realized the problem, thousands of users [B] already experienced data loss, which [C] had costed millions in damages.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] had realized | [B] had already experienced | [C] had cost!
items.feedback_wrong: [A] has→had. [B] cần had already. [C] cost-cost-cost (không phải costed).
items.explanation_short: [A] has realized → had realized. [B] already experienced → had already experienced. [C] had costed → had cost.
items.ielts_tip: cost-cost-cost, cut-cut-cut, put-put-put = V1=V2=V3. Không thêm -ed!

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic
